Research Area: Secure and Reliable SRAM Memory Design.
Recent activities and Achievements

At the VLSI Design Lab of IET, we have successfully fabricated our Error Correction Code (ECC) Chip in Malaysia using SkyWater 130nm Technology Node. This milestone makes us the first state university in Madhya Pradesh and among the leading institutions in India to achieve such a feat in chip design.

Object of this fabricated chip is to detect and correct any one-bit error during memory Read and Write Process. The error correction and detection method is based on Hamming Code and the most unique feature of this chip is to have Built In Self-Test.

IET is a proud participant in the Chip2Startup (C2S) project, an initiative by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). Under this scheme, we have received a grant of ₹1 crore and access to advanced VLSI EDA tools, including Cadence, Synopsys, Vivado, and more. Our key partners in this project include IIT Indore, IIT Jammu, IIITM Gwalior, and SGSITS Indore.
